column3: P5: debug.getinfo(1,"t").istailcall must be true without a hook; Fable tail marks exist only while a call hook is installed (db.lua:619). nups/getlocal now match.

PENDING: cross-coroutine C-call inheritance not shipped. The resume fast path must give the resumed thread the resumer's C-call count + 1, but with the inheritance a deep chain of nested coroutine.resume calls took the fast path's ->fff_fallback at ~200 levels and the C handler (ffh_resume -> lj_vm_resume) SIGSEGVed on x86_64, where PUC 5.4.9 raises a clean "C stack overflow" at 198. Needs a bound error that does not re-enter the C handler. See docs/notes/resume-chain-crash.md.
